summary: Full-stack e2e testing of ZIHAMO /shop feature + landing regression. Backend orders/enquiries APIs (pytest, 5/5 passed) and complete UI flow (splash -> browse -> filter/search/chip -> quick add -> product page qty stepper -> related nav -> cart with persistence -> checkout -> success ZH order number -> cart cleared -> landing nav Shop link) all pass.

issues: Tailwind class contains duplicated padding classes 'py-4.5 py-[18px]' — the invalid 'py-4.5' is ignored, cosmetic only, safe to clean up.

action_items: Spec listed card testid as 'shop-card-{id}' but implementation uses 'shop-product-{id}'. Not a bug per se — decide whether to update spec or rename testid for consistency.
Minor: clean up duplicated 'py-4.5 py-[18px]' class on place-order button in CheckoutPage.jsx.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/orders creates orders correctly, excludes Mongo _id in GET list. Good.
CheckoutPage.jsx: submits directly to backend, clears cart, navigates to success — clean. Error path only shows toast (no visible error state), acceptable for MVP.
shopCart zustand persist localStorage key 'zihamo-shop-cart' — persistence verified via reload.
Splash uses sessionStorage flag so subsequent /shop visits skip splash — verified only in same session.
seed_data_creation: Created a few test orders (TEST_ prefixed emails) and one enquiry via API + one order via UI (ZH46515B). All persisted in Mongo 'orders'/'enquiries' collections.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Card testid on ShopHome is 'shop-product-{id}' (not shop-card). Checkout inputs use 'checkout-{name}' testids. Cart proceed button testid is 'proceed-to-checkout'. Backend order_no format is 'ZH' + 6 hex uppercase (8 chars total). All flows verified end-to-end on preview URL.
